mapper.select: select duc.dates, duc.pkg, 0 `user_type`, duc.version `version`, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Organic') user_source, count(DISTINCT duc.user_id) user_num from dwd_user_conversion duc left join dim_user_source dus on (dus.user_id = duc.user_id) where duc.dates = #{dates} group by duc.dates, duc.pkg, duc.version, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Organic')

select duc.dates, duc.pkg, 1 `user_type`, duc.version `version`, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Organic') user_source, count(DISTINCT duc.user_id) user_num from dwd_user_conversion duc left join dim_user_source dus on (dus.user_id = duc.user_id) where duc.dates = #{dates} and duc.dates = duc.register_dates group by duc.dates, duc.pkg, duc.version, IFNULL(dus.network, 'Organic');
